rootCauseHypothesis:
The test could not find a visible, enabled button matching the accessible role/name, likely because the CTA is not being rendered in time or its accessible label differs from the expected value. Common hosting-side causes include slow page hydration/JavaScript execution, late-loading content, an overlay or cookie consent blocking the button, or a markup/accessibility change that alters the button’s name (for example, icon text being appended/removed). Underlying error: TimeoutError: Locator.click: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - waiting for get_by_role("button", name="Solicitar Presupuesto arrow_forward", exact=True)

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Ensure the page renders a clickable button with the exact accessible name 'Solicitar Presupuesto arrow_forward' within 10 seconds. Check that the CTA is not hidden behind cookie banners, overlays, lazy-loading, or delayed JS hydration. Verify the button text/icon combination does not change the accessible name unexpectedly, and that the element is not disabled, offscreen, or inside an iframe/shadow DOM inaccessible to the test. If the page is slow, reduce initial load time or render a server-side fallback so the button appears sooner.
